queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'FreeCAD%' AND publisher = 'FreeCAD Team';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'FreeCAD%' AND publisher = 'FreeCAD Team' AND version_compare(version, '1.1.4') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'freecad.exe');
